text:
VDI::enable
Description
This command enables the VDI plugin in the flow.
Syntax
VDI
::
enable
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
VDI
::
enable
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED, HTTP_REQUEST
Introduced: BIGIP-11.4.0
